fields.description: The rule this delta targets (ADR-0031): the condition of an app/Site/default rule to recolor or hide, or a new condition of the user's own rule. Blank is the catch-all. Stored canonically so the identity match holds.
fields.label: Condition

fields.description: The pill text. Absent for a hide.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: The pill color token (e.g. green, orange, gray). Defaults to gray.
fields.label: Color

fields.description: A non-destructive personal hide (tombstone): suppresses the matching app/Site/default rule for this user's own view only, leaving the source untouched (ADR-0031).
fields.label: Hidden
